content:
anya-peopleops: Hey @devon — congrats on the new hire starting Mon. Quick thread to sync a lightweight Day‑1 checklist + a simple 30/60/90 you can share. Can you confirm any extra access they'll need beyond the usual?

devon-manager: Thanks! Mostly standard Eng lead needs: Slack, Google Drive, GitHub org, Jira, Redwood Console, and access to the Dedicated project for perf testing. Also a laptop request — 32GB preferred.

anya-peopleops: Got it. Fast checklist I usually use:
- before Day 1: create Okta user, invite to Slack, add to Google groups, add to GitHub team
- Day 1 AM: HR intro (pay/benefits), paperwork, security training
- Day 1 PM: team intro, tooling walkthrough, assign buddy

For access requests please open the access form: https://intranet.redwood/access-requests and include the GitHub org/team names + GCP project id. If you want I can raise the laptop order with procurement (lead time ~5-7 biz days).

kevin-sre: For Dedicated project access we'll need: GCP project id + list of service accounts. Also add them to the "redwood-dedicated-devs" IAM group. If you want early access to test infra, mention that in the access form and tag me.

devon-manager: GCP project is "rwd-inference-infra-dev". I'll add service account names tonight. Pairing request: can we get a 30m infra intro in Week 1?

kevin-sre: yep — I can do Tue 11:00. I'll cover VPN/KMS access and Dedicated pool etiquette.

zoe-hr: Manager checklist reminders:
- schedule 1:1s for week 1 and recurring weekly 1:1s after
- set clear success criteria for first 30 days (onboarding tasks + small technical deliverable)
- share 30/60/90 doc with expectations and check-in dates

Quick 30/60/90 template we use:
- 30 days: ramp up (access + docs, small bug fix or feature), attend core product demos
- 60 days: own a small project, start contributing to roadmap discussions, lead 1 team retro
- 90 days: deliver a measurable change (perf/cost/improve reliability), present status to PM/Eng leaders

anya-peopleops: Sample Day 1 agenda to copy into their calendar: 
- 09:00 — Welcome + HR onboarding (zoe-hr)
- 10:00 — Security & VPN setup (kevin-sre)
- 11:00 — Team intro (team standup + quick rundowns)
- 12:00 — Welcome lunch (virtual/in-person)
- 13:00 — Console/GitHub/Jira access walkthrough (devon-manager)
- 15:00 — Buddy pairing + first small task assigned

devon-manager: Perfect. I'll assign @maya as the buddy and add the 1:1s. Can you drop the 30/60/90 doc link here when you have it?

onboard-bot: :tada: New hire profile created for maya@example.com — calendar invites sent for Day 1 events.

anya-peopleops: Dropping the template: https://intranet.redwood/templates/30-60-90-onboarding (the doc is editable — copy then customize). Also ping me if procurement delays the laptop and we'll make a temporary loaner plan.

devon-manager: Thanks everyone — I'll finish the access form tonight and confirm buddy + first task. Appreciate the quick sync. :rocket:
